# Phillips

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolmaster at Avonlea school  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Mr. Phillips is a schoolmaster who wears a mustache that he frequently curls.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)_

## Personality

Mr. Phillips is sarcastic, strict, and prone to spasmodic fits of reform, often carrying out punishments with a high hand. He shows clear partiality toward older students, particularly Prissy Andrews, whom he courts while neglecting younger pupils. Despite his flaws, he delivers farewell speeches with emotional sincerity.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P57](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0057), [v1 c15 P60](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0060), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## History

Mr. Phillips serves as the schoolmaster in Avonlea, where he spends much of his classroom time attending to sixteen-year-old Prissy Andrews under the guise of helping her with her lessons. When Anne Shirley attends school, he subjects her to public mortification by holding up her slate for poor spelling and forcing her to stand on the platform after she hits Gilbert Blythe for teasing her. The following day, he makes Anne sit with Gilbert as a scapegoat punishment for tardiness, prompting Anne to temporarily leave school. During his tenure, he whips Sam Boulter for talking back, leading to a confrontation with Sam's father. At an evening concert, he recites Mark Antony's oration over Cæsar's body while gazing at Prissy Andrews. On his final day of teaching at the end of June, he delivers a tearful farewell speech before leaving Avonlea school.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P45](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0045), [v1 c15 P60](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0060), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P77](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0077), [v1 c16 P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c21 P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## Background by volume

- secured the Avonlea school position through his uncle, who was a school trustee  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- boarded at Eben Wright's house while teaching in Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056)</sub>
